mostWorthwhile.text: Building the hair-cell and membrane assembly was most worthwhile: the planned inset connects relative motion to bundle bending, and the cochlea result links that bending to nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the hearing pathways was rather brief: the schematic names brain pathways but gives little detail about their relays or processing.

surprise.text: The sound-conducting ears could not connect directly to the empty cochlear chambers; the sensory structures had to be assembled first.

arbitrary.text: That assembly order was not obvious from the initial anatomical descriptions. The failed attempt clarified the game requirement, but not why the physical connection had to wait.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter offered similarly concrete structure-to-function connections, though the mostly sequential fittings and brief pathway descriptions make me less eager for more of the same.
